description: A tall hyena-headed creature with shaggy brown fur flecked with black, a long toothy snout, pointed ears and one fierce red eye. It wears a sleeveless salmon-red leather vest edged with small studs, a belt with a long white sword across the waist, and a skirt of hanging red leather strips. Its right hand holds a broad short blade raised high beside its head, point up. It is shown half-length, turned three-quarters to the viewer's left, at the party's eye level. Behind it stands a row of pale stone balusters against a flat grey wall, with a rough white-and-cyan flagstone floor below. Warm browns and reds stand against cold greys; the mood is tense. Frame 1: the creature stands poised with blade up. Frame 2: its chest and shoulders lift slightly as it breathes. Frame 3: its far arm and flank shift as the vest swells. Frame 4: it settles back toward the first pose. All four frames are equally brief, so the loop reads as a quick, restless heaving of breath while it holds the sword ready.
title: Gnoll with a raised sword
